Wallets.title: Your wallets
Wallets.description: Keep accounts, cards, savings and investments in one place.

chart.title: Wealth distribution
chart.description: Distribution of the current balance across all wallets.

dialog.createDescription: Add an account, a card or a wallet to keep track of.
dialog.editDescription: Changes remain in this browser session and are not sent to the backend.

cardDescriptions.debit: Connect a card that draws funds directly from one of your accounts.
cardDescriptions.credit: Track a card whose balance is collected from a linked account on a set day.
cardDescriptions.prepaid: Manage a card with its own balance and optional top-ups.
